verdict: Meta efficiency jumped sharply; Google and key launch milestones remain undeployed.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta delivered 8 leads at $72.99 per lead — and this past week alone, lead volume surged 600% while cost per lead dropped 81% compared to the week prior, a real efficiency gain driven by the instant-form campaign format. That said, 8 leads over 28 days is a modest base, and the full program is not yet running: Google Ads has not launched, meaning the roughly $5,000 monthly Google budget has not been put to work. Five planned launch milestones — including LSA verification, site and landing pages, and Meta retargeting — were scheduled for late July and early August and are not yet confirmed complete; getting those across the finish line is the immediate priority. Once Google Search and LSA are live, you should see a meaningful increase in total lead volume that Meta alone cannot produce.

highlights.phrase: increase in leads this week versus the prior week on Meta
cost per lead over the last 28 days, down 81% week-over-week
spent on Google Ads this period — that channel has not launched yet

watch_item.issue: Five launch milestones originally due July 31–August 1 are not confirmed complete, leaving Google Ads, LSA, and Meta retargeting undeployed.
watch_item.fix: We are actively working to close each open milestone so Google Search, LSA, and Meta retargeting can go live and the full budget is put to work.
